title: Wh- Questions
goal: By the end of this lesson, you can ask Wh- questions: how long, how far, what+N, which+N, how much/many/often. You can choose the right question word and build natural questions.

examples.text: How long have you worked here?
How often do you have meetings?
How often do you go to the gym?

items.def: asks about amount of uncountable noun

examples.text: How much time do you have?
How much coffee do you drink?

items.def: asks about number of countable noun

examples.text: How many meetings do you have?
How many friends do you have here?
What kind of work do you do?
What kind of music do you like?

items.def: asks about choice from a group

examples.text: Which day is better for you?

items.def: makes a suggestion or asks for opinion

examples.text: How about going to the beach?

vocab.text: Choose two people. Ask them Wh- questions. Answer with full sentences.

head: Question word
Asks about
Structure
Example
rows: How long have you worked here?
How often do you have meetings?
How much + N + do/does + S + V?
How much time do you have?
How many + N + do/does + S + V?
How many meetings do you have?

head: Pattern
Use
Example
rows: What kind of work do you do?
Which day is better, Monday or Tuesday?
Which café do you prefer, A or B?

reading.text: I work as a sales manager. I have been working here for three years. My office is about two kilometers from my house. I usually have three meetings every day. I drink too much coffee, but I try to exercise every weekend. How about you?
Notice: how long (duration), how far (distance), how often (frequency), how much (uncountable), how many (countable).

roleplay.title: 60-second engine challenge
roleplay.context: Work with a partner. Take turns asking and answering Wh- questions.
steps: Partner A asks: How long…? / How far…? / How often…?
Partner B answers with full sentences.
Partner A asks: How much…? / How many…? / What kind of…? / Which…?
Partner B answers with full sentences.
Switch roles. Keep it fast — 10 seconds per question.
roleplay.useful: How long have you worked here? · How far is the office? · How often do you have meetings? · How much time do you have? · How many meetings do you have? · What kind of work do you do? · Which day is better?

finalTask.text: Work with a partner. Have a 3-minute conversation using Wh- questions. Ask about work, daily life, preferences. Use How long, How far, How often, How much, How many, What kind of, Which, How about.
Goal: 10+ questions, 10+ full answers. Notice when you use each question word correctly.
